episodes.title: 1. Meet
episodes.summary: Stuck in a secret relationship, shy Charlie starts to crush on Nick, the school's popular rugby star, and joins the team against his friends' advice.

episodes.title: 2. Crush
episodes.summary: Elle struggles to settle into her new school as Charlie and Tao are convinced Nick is straight. Nick starts to question his unfamiliar feelings.

episodes.title: 3. Kiss
episodes.summary: Sparks fly at a birthday party where Nick's friend Tara confides in him. Inspired, Nick shares his feelings with Charlie — and they grow even closer.

episodes.title: 4. Secret
episodes.summary: Charlie and Nick agree to keep their relationship a secret at school while Nick figures things out. Nick's friend Imogen asks him out on a date.

episodes.title: 5. Friend
episodes.summary: Nick decides whether he should skip his date with Imogen for Charlie's birthday. Tao vows to protect Charlie from Nick and his rude rugby friends.

episodes.title: 6. Girls
episodes.summary: Tara makes her relationship official on social media, but she isn't ready for the side effects. The friends try to play matchmaker with Elle and Tao.

episodes.title: 7. Bully
episodes.summary: After both Nick and Tao get into fights with Harry, Charlie worries that he's making Nick's life too difficult and straining his friendship with Tao.

episodes.title: 8. Boyfriend
episodes.summary: As the boys and girls schools meet for a Sports Day, Charlie's on the brink of breaking it all off with Nick while Elle and Tao share a special moment.

episodes.title: 1. Out
episodes.summary: As his relationship with Charlie matures, Nick considers coming out to Imogen — but it's a lot harder than he expected. Elle tries flirting with Tao.

episodes.title: 2. Family
episodes.summary: With Charlie's grades slipping, his parents tighten the rules. Tao's jealous when Elle makes new friends. Nick's older brother invades his privacy.

episodes.title: 3. Promise
episodes.summary: Nick tries to come out to some of his teammates at a bonfire party after exams. Tao plans the perfect date. Things get weird between Tara and Darcy.

episodes.title: 4. Challenge
episodes.summary: On a school trip to Paris, Nick and Charlie try to keep their relationship under wraps. Elle and Tao reconnect at a museum. Imogen stands up to Ben.

episodes.title: 5. Heat
episodes.summary: Rumors spread when Charlie wakes up with something on his neck. A group tour of the city's most famous sights reveals more than one major secret.

episodes.title: 6. Truth / Dare
episodes.summary: On their last day in Paris, Nick introduces Charlie to his dad. Elle and Tao make it official. The truth comes out at a party that's full of surprises.

episodes.title: 7. Sorry
episodes.summary: Elle keeps big news from Tao, Ben pressures Charlie to forgive him, and Isaac opens up to James. Nick invites Charlie to a tense family dinner.

episodes.title: 8. Perfect
episodes.summary: The gang comes together for a memorable prom with a fitting theme: "Summer of Love." But with someone important missing... it feels incomplete.

episodes.title: 1. Love
episodes.summary: On a trip to the beach, Charlie's desperate to tell Nick how he feels — but Nick also has something he wants to discuss. Tao plans a summer of romance.

episodes.title: 2. Home
episodes.summary: On holiday in Menorca, Nick worries about Charlie, who is struggling more than ever. Isaac starts to feel like a third wheel around Elle and Tao.

episodes.title: 3. Talk
episodes.summary: It's a new term, and Tao misses Elle now they're at different schools. Charlie plans a birthday surprise for Nick, who's still worried for his boyfriend.

episodes.title: 4. Journey
episodes.summary: Charlie seeks medical help and begins the long road to recovery. Nick starts keeping a journal, and Tao makes a video to support his absent friend.

episodes.title: 5. Winter
episodes.summary: It's a tough Christmas for Charlie, and his family — except for Tori — isn't helping. Elle and Tao talk about sex, and sparks fly at a New Year's party.

episodes.title: 6. Body
episodes.summary: Elle's art going viral on social media lands her an interview. Charlie tells Nick he's ready to go to the next level and Tara suffers a panic attack.

episodes.title: 7. Together
episodes.summary: As the school year comes to an end and the students begin thinking about their futures, Charlie and Nick struggle to find a moment alone together.

episodes.title: 8. Apart
episodes.summary: Nick and the girls go on a road trip to look at unis, as he tries to decide whether to stay near Charlie or move away. Sahar's band plays at a fete.
